## What's Changed
* Release 0.2.0: TA-Lib 0.8.1, all 201 indicators and tested portable wheels by @Yvictor in https://github.com/Yvictor/polars_ta_extension/pull/38
* ci: publish releases from a manual workflow run by @Yvictor in https://github.com/Yvictor/polars_ta_extension/pull/40

## Notes
* Published PyPI wheels for macOS x86_64, macOS arm64, Linux x86_64 (glibc and musl), Linux aarch64 (glibc and musl), Windows x64 and Windows ARM64, plus the sdist. TA-Lib 0.8.1 is statically linked, so no system TA-Lib is required (fixes #24, #36).
* 43 new indicators (AC, ACCBANDS, ADR, AO, AVGDEV, CMF, CMOU, COPPOCK, CUMSUM, CVI, DONCHIAN, DPO, EFI, ER, ERI, FOSC, FRACTAL, HA, HMA, IMI, KC, KDJ, MARKETFI, MASSI, NVI, PERCENTILE, PERCENTRANK, PVI, PVO, PVT, QSTICK, RMA, RVI, RVOL, SMI, SUPERTREND, TSI, VHF, VORTEX, VWAP, VWMA, WAD, ZLEMA) and all 14 `MA_Type` modes (fixes #26).
* Behavior changes to match upstream defaults: BBANDS `timeperiod` 20, APO/PPO `matype` EMA, CDLDARKCLOUDCOVER/CDLMATHOLD `penetration` 0.5. See the [upgrade guide](https://github.com/Yvictor/polars_ta_extension/blob/0.2.0/docs/upgrade-0.2.0.md).
* Typed `.ta` namespace with `py.typed` and `polars_talib.col()` (fixes #28); whole-number float periods accepted (fixes #6); clear `TypeError`/`ValueError` for invalid integer parameters.
* Installable AI skill for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor: see [docs/skills.md](https://github.com/Yvictor/polars_ta_extension/blob/0.2.0/docs/skills.md).
* Requires CPython 3.10+ and Polars >=1.20,<2.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Yvictor/polars_ta_extension/compare/0.1.6...0.2.0
